summary: Tampere University offers a small number of scholarships covering 50% of tuition for the length of the programme: nine across all programmes in the 2026 admission. Other fee-paying students get €2,000 off their first year if they accept and pay within 21 days.
meta_description: Tampere's tuition fee scholarship covers 50% of fees. Others get €2,000 off the first year. Master's applications run 14 December 2026 to 7 January 2027.
covers: 50% of the tuition fee for the length of the programme.
The early bird offer instead takes €2,000 off the first year, for fee-paying students without the scholarship.
eligibility: Fee-paying students: citizens of countries outside the EU, EEA and Switzerland on an English-taught bachelor's or master's.
The scholarship goes to a very small number of exceptionally qualified applicants, and not every programme awards one.
The early bird offer needs no application: accept your place and pay within 21 days of hearing about admission.
how_to_apply: Apply on Studyinfo.fi between 14 December 2026, 8:00, and 7 January 2027, 23:59 (UTC+2) for an English-taught master's.
Apply for the scholarship in that same application, including a scholarship letter if your programme asks for one.
You hear about the scholarship together with your admission result.
watch_out: It covers half the fee, and awards are very few: nine in the 2026 admission.
Bachelor's applicants should check Tampere's own bachelor's dates, and scholarships are not available on open university routes or transfers.
costs: Tuition fee for students admitted in 2027: €12,000 a year for a master's, €10,000 for a bachelor's
50% is covered if you win the scholarship; you pay the rest
documents: Your Studyinfo.fi application with your educational documents.
A scholarship letter if your programme asks for one.

faq.q: How much does the Tampere University scholarship cover?
faq.a: 50% of the tuition fee for the length of the programme. In the 2026 admission, nine were awarded across all bachelor's and master's programmes.

faq.q: What is the Tampere early bird offer?
faq.a: €2,000 off the first year, for fee-paying students without the scholarship who accept their place and pay the reduced fee within 21 days of hearing about admission.

sources.title: Tampere University: Tuition fees and scholarships
